kebab_example: aliyun cms create-alarm --name abc --namespace acs_ecs_dashboard --metric-name CPUUtilization --dimensions instanceId_:_i-2zecrzcri3d6fhd2ff7j --statistics Average --comparison-operator example-string --threshold 90 --api-version 2018-03-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAlarm

parameters.help_en: The name of the alert rule
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The name of the product. Specify the value based on the project of each product, such as acs_ecs_dashboard and acs_rds_dashboard
parameters.help_zh: 产品名称，参考各产品对应的project，例如acs_ecs_dashboard， acs_rds_dashboard等
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The name of the metric. Specify the value based on the metric definition of each product
parameters.help_zh: 相应产品对应的监控项名称，参考各产品metric定义
parameters.name: metric_name

parameters.help_en: The list of instances associated with the alert rule. The value is a JSON array string, such as `[{"instanceId":"name1"},{"instanceId":"name2"}]`
parameters.help_zh: 报警规则对应实例列表，为json array对应的string，例如`[{“instanceId”:”name1”},{“instanceId”:”name2”}]`
parameters.name: dimensions

parameters.help_en: The period for querying the metric. The value must be consistent with the defined metric. Default value: 300. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询指标的周期，必须与定义的metric一致，默认300，单位为秒
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The statistical method. The value must be consistent with the defined metric, such as Average
parameters.help_zh: 统计方法，必须与定义的metric一致，例如Average
parameters.name: statistics

parameters.help_en: The comparison operator for the alert. Valid values: `<=, <, >, >=, ==, !=`
parameters.help_zh: 报警比较符，只能为以下几种`<=，<，>，>=，==，!=`
parameters.name: comparison_operator

parameters.help_en: The alert threshold. Only numeric values are supported
parameters.help_zh: 报警阈值，目前只开放数值类型功能
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: The number of consecutive detection times that the threshold condition must be met before an alert is triggered. Default value: 3
parameters.help_zh: 连续探测几次都满足阈值条件时报警，默认3次
parameters.name: evaluation_count

parameters.help_en: The alert contact groups to be notified by the alert rule. The groups must already be created in the console. The value is a JSON array string, such as `["ContactGroup1","ContactGroup2"]`
parameters.help_zh: 报警规则通知的联系组，必须在控制台上已创建，为json array对应的string，例如`[“联系组1”，”联系组2”]`
parameters.name: contact_groups

parameters.help_en: The start time of the effective period during which the alert rule takes effect. Default value: 0, which indicates 00:00
parameters.help_zh: 报警生效时间的开始时间，默认0，代表0点
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the effective period during which the alert rule takes effect. Default value: 24, which indicates 24:00
parameters.help_zh: 报警生效时间的结束时间，默认24，代表24点
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The mute period during which the alert remains in the triggered state. Default value: 86400. Unit: seconds. Minimum value: 3600 (1 hour)
parameters.help_zh: 一直处于报警状态的通知沉默周期，默认86400，单位s，最小1小时
parameters.name: silence_time

parameters.help_en:
The notification method. Valid values:
0: TradeManager and email.
1: TradeManager, email, and text message
parameters.help_zh: 通知类型，为0是旺旺+邮件，为1是旺旺+邮件+短信
parameters.name: notify_type

parameters.help_en: The callback function. Only public URLs are supported. For more information about callback parameters, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/60714.html
parameters.help_zh: 回调函数，只支持公网地址，回调参数请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/60714.html
parameters.name: webhook

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to check the availability of the webhook URL
parameters.name: dry_run

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates success. A non-200 value indicates failure
Code.description_zh: 请求失败状态码，200为成功，非200为失败

Data.description_en: The ID of the alert rule

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to query logs

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
